source_based_scope: Single elementary row operation, 3×3 matrix, five-choice radio, moderate arithmetic. No new operators, prerequisite tasks or response requirements.
extension: Alternative elementary source-bank choices become correct. Noninteger targets from simple rational scaling/addition remain one-step arithmetic supported by tutorial 3150. Two non-elementary replacement distractors never become correct.
restriction_assessment: Bounded source-bank coefficients and one-entry perturbations conserve workload. Complete banks and all 48 eligible roles survive delivery, so recognizing a bank/sign/zero layout alone cannot fix a qualifying operation. Does not claim unrestricted matrix sampling.
